Render a Lines (PR diff) bullet in /implement final reports with N/A degradation on missing data

commit_message:
Add PR diff line counts to /implement final report

Introduce compute-pr-line-counts.sh to split merged PR additions/deletions into
code and larch-logs buckets from the GitHub PR files API. Wire the counts through
write-final-report.sh into render-run-summary.sh as an implement-only bullet,
with N/A when no PR, repo-unavailable, or gh failure. Add offline harnesses and
Makefile/agent-lint registration.
